content: We distinguish two categories of answerable questions: The category text-based was assigned to questions that can be answered from the text directly. If the answer could only be inferred by using commonsense knowledge, the category script-based was assigned. Making this distinction is interesting for evaluation purposes, since it enables us to estimate the number of commonsense inference questions. For questions that did not make sense at all given a text, unfitting was assigned. If a question made sense for a text, but it was impossible to find an answer, the label unknown was used.
